scripts.build: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/api && npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @privacy-round-trip/api" "npm run dev -w @privacy-round-trip/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @privacy-round-trip/e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/api && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/web && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
